title: Updating the Number-of-Runs Register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $5$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its number-of-runs field to $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 5 equal to its number-of-runs field. Replacing coordinate 5 of
this vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing
its number-of-runs field by $y$.
